name: ListPlayers
description: List connected players with their Steam ids.

name: Broadcast
description: Show a message in the middle of every player's screen.

name: ServerChat
description: Send a chat message to everyone as SERVER.

name: ServerChatTo
description: Send a private chat message to one player by Steam id.

name: ServerChatToPlayer
description: Send a private chat message to one player by name (quote names with spaces).

name: GetChat
description: Show the chat messages since the last GetChat.

name: SetMessageOfTheDay
description: Set the message shown to players when they join.

name: ShowMessageOfTheDay
description: Show the message of the day to everyone.

name: SaveWorld
description: Save the world to disk now.

name: DoExit
description: Save and shut the server down.

name: KickPlayer
description: Disconnect a player. They can join again.

name: BanPlayer
description: Ban a player and add them to BanList.txt.

name: UnbanPlayer
description: Remove a player from the ban list.

name: AllowPlayerToJoinNoCheck
description: Add a player to the whitelist (PlayersJoinNoCheckList.txt).

name: DisallowPlayerToJoinNoCheck
description: Remove a player from the whitelist.

name: GetPlayerIDForSteamID
description: Find a player's in-game id from their Steam id.

name: GetSteamIDForPlayerID
description: Find a player's Steam id from their in-game id.

name: GetTribeIdPlayerList
description: List the members of a tribe.

name: RenamePlayer
description: Rename a player's survivor (quote names with spaces).

name: RenameTribe
description: Rename a tribe (quote names with spaces).

name: KillPlayer
description: Kill a player's survivor by in-game id.

name: ClearPlayerInventory
description: Empty a player's inventory, slots and/or equipment.

name: GiveExpToPlayer
description: Give experience to a player.

name: GiveItemToPlayer
description: Give an item by blueprint path.

name: GiveItemNumToPlayer
description: Give an item by item number.

name: TeleportPlayerIDToPlayerID
description: Teleport one player to another.

name: ForcePlayerToJoinTribe
description: Put a player in a tribe.

name: DestroyTribeId
description: Destroy a tribe with all its players, dinos and structures.

name: DestroyTribeIdDinos
description: Destroy every tamed dino of a tribe.

name: DestroyTribeIdPlayers
description: Destroy every survivor of a tribe.

name: DestroyTribeIdStructures
description: Destroy every structure of a tribe.

name: DestroyWildDinos
description: Remove all wild dinos so they respawn fresh.

name: DestroyAll
description: Destroy every actor of a class.

name: DestroyStructures
description: Destroy every structure on the map.

name: SetTimeOfDay
description: Set the in-game time (hh:mm or hh:mm:ss).

name: Slomo
description: Change the game speed (1 is normal).

name: PlayersOnly
description: Freeze everything except players (toggle).
